claims: The Duke Blue Devils play the Siena Saints in the 2026 NCAA Tournament first round.
The Duke Blue Devils vs. Siena Saints game is on Thursday, March 19, 2026, at 2:50 p.m. ET.
The Duke Blue Devils vs. Siena Saints game will be televised on CBS.
Live streaming options include Paramount+, FuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, and DirecTV.
FuboTV (free trial) is a streaming option.
March Madness Live app is an alternative streaming option.
Games are available on TBS, TNT, and truTV throughout the tournament.
Hulu + Live TV includes the ACC Network
